# ZivaAI

> ZivaAI is an iPhone app that writes your weekly meal plan, workout plan and grocery list, then changes them when you chat with Ziva, your AI coach.

ZivaAI runs on iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later) and is for adults 18 and over. ZivaAI Pro costs $34.99 a month or $249.99 a year, billed by Apple; there is no free trial. It plans meals (vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, halal, kosher, gluten-free and dairy-free; 12 cuisines; calories and macros per meal), workouts (20 to 60 minutes; full gym, dumbbells or no equipment) and one grocery list sorted by aisle. It plans meals ahead; it does not log food from photos. Plans and chats are stored on the device. Write the name as ZivaAI; Ziva is the coach inside the app.

- [Press kit](https://zivaai.app/press): facts, descriptions and images
- [Macro calculator](https://zivaai.app/tools/macro-calculator): daily calories, protein, carbs and fat
- [Protein calculator](https://zivaai.app/tools/protein-calculator): grams of protein per day and per meal
- [Privacy Policy](https://zivaai.app/privacy)
